content.caption:
出門工作八小時。
回家看到牠坐著不動。
原來是在等我開罐頭，不是想我。
content.scene: In a cozy, sun-drenched living room, 小夜, a solid black short-haired cat with striking green eyes and a small white chest patch, sits perfectly upright on a wooden floor. He maintains a dignified, observant pose, staring intensely at a closed tin can rather than the door, his expression one of dry, judgmental patience. Hand-painted book illustration style with soft, natural light.
